 Micron, Nvidia, Lam Research removed from BofA's US 1 list
 Less than 1 min read MU NVDA LRCX Key points: Micron , Nvidia , and Lam Research were removed from Bank of America's US 1 list on Tuesday. 
 The firm did not provide a reason for the removal of the trio from its top stocks pick list, but added that they still have Buy ratings. 
 Shares of the three semiconductor-related stocks were lower in premarket trading.
